feedback_protocols.normal: proposal prompt sees only allowlisted selection metrics; search selection uses combined_score; search receives only allowlisted feasibility/selection metrics; evaluator-only validation, mechanism, robustness and per-instance metrics remain in the trusted trace
feedback_protocols.score_only: proposal prompts receive only the scalar combined_score for the true-score-selected current incumbent; validity, feasibility, raw-score and diagnostic fields are omitted; evaluator-only metrics remain sealed; this is a feedback-bandwidth treatment, not a no-feedback control
feedback_protocols.delayed_replay: one-proposal delayed replay: proposal k sees the best program and allowlisted metrics released only through proposal k-2 (the baseline is available at start); each evaluated proposal is released on that fixed lag, while the observer retains all scores for offline final selection; search receives only allowlisted feasibility/selection metrics; evaluator-only validation, mechanism, robustness and per-instance metrics remain in the trusted trace
feedback_protocols.selection_blind: open-loop proposal batch: every proposal sees the frozen baseline program and its allowlisted baseline metrics; evaluated scores are retained only for offline best-of-batch analysis and never change a later parent or prompt; search receives only allowlisted feasibility/selection metrics; evaluator-only validation, mechanism, robustness and per-instance metrics remain in the trusted trace
